recipe.title: Pad Thai Noodles
recipe.ingredient: 4-5 Chicken thigh fillets stripped (omitted for vegetarian and can replace with tofu)
recipe.step: Get all ingredients out and ready.
Place noodles in a large bowl and cover with boiling water for 10 minutes.
While you wait for the noodles combine the chilli and fish sauce, lime juice and sugar in a small bowl together, and set aside.
Once the noodles are done drain and rinse under cold water, then set aside.
Heat oil in large pan or wok.
Cook garlic and chicken in batches, until all done.
Remove chicken from pan and keep warm at the bake of the stove.
Add more oil to the pan and cook the eggs, stirring to get a scrambled like constantly.
Once eggs are cooked add drained noodles to the pan along with the chicken and other ingredients except the nuts and chilli.
Mix well and stir gently until it is completely heated through.
Serve in bowls with nuts and red chilli slices as garnish, if desired.
